'''Vontifor''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they commanded a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Republic cruiser]] in [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] task force during the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]].
